placements.title: perspective becomes the durable asset when substrate commoditizes
placements.frame: When the substrate becomes a commodity, what is the asset worth keeping — and does owned intelligence differ from rented?
placements.why: Both expressions perform the same thematic claim: owned intelligence is categorically distinct from rented intelligence, and when the substrate commoditizes, the perspective — not the tool — is the retained asset. This names a subject future envelopes will keep feeding: where durable value resides when capabilities become commodities. The existing graph and strata are both empty, so nothing existing holds this theme.
